$ podkop device 192.168.2.5
# in Only for devices of two rules (TV and lan)
exit 0
--- stdout
ℹ️ The rules for 192.168.2.5, in the order they are matched:
➖ Rule bank does not take it: only for 192.168.1.30
➖ Rule ads does not take it: only for 192.168.1.20
✅ Rule TV (tv) takes its connections to the lists of the rule, as one of its devices: through its servers
➖ Rule pc does not take it: only for 192.168.3.0/24, 2001:db8:3::/64
✅ Rule lan takes its connections to the lists of the rule, as one of its devices: through its servers
❌ Rule bad takes no device: no item of "only for devices" is an address or a subnet
➡️ What no rule takes goes directly
